title: Unified Model Graphs: An Introduction
text: Unified Model Graph (UMG) types every vertex three dimensions: observability (fill: shaded = observed), support (shape: circle = continuous, square = categorical), inferential role (border dedicated shapes: diamond = fixed unknown parameter, triangle = known constant, double border = deterministic). Edges distinguish stochastic dependence, symmetric covariance, deterministic assignment, mixture selection. Plates encode replication; nesting encodes hierarchy. Every well-formed diagram corresponds likelihood factorization, diagram model.
